dashboard/src/views/dashboard/pipelines/PipelinesView.vue:74-82 and components/NewPipelineDialog.vue:57-79 give New pipeline, Name and Make pipeline, and the editor opens at once (PipelinesView.vue:68-72). WorkbenchView.vue:787-798 has Add a step at the end, which opens Steps to add with Find a step (StepPalette.vue:80-130, i18n/en.json:278-283). The start line reads Starts when someone types !name (WorkbenchView.vue:163-172, 756-762).

server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/PipelinesController.cs:257-284: POST test-run needs pipelines:write, which defaults to Moderator (Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:184). It returns 409 LIVE_RUN_IN_PROGRESS for a second live run. Editor runs are filed with trigger kind test_run or manual_live (Infrastructure/Platform/Pipeline/PipelineEngine.cs:2512-2535, 2568-2574). RunsPanel.vue:114-119 labels them Test run and Live run (en.json:247-248), and a real command start has no label. Step cards show Done, Failed or Did not run (stepRun.ts, StepCard.vue:205). The summary reads Test run N: X steps ran. (WorkbenchView.vue:700-705, en.json:203).

Infrastructure/Platform/Pipeline/PipelineTestRunService.cs:52-61: only set_variable, stop, pick_from_list and check_balance run in a dry run, and every other action is wrapped in CapturingCommandAction (lines 157-167), which returns Success (CapturingCommandAction.cs:50-79). Live mode uses the real action set (line 158) and starts as the caller (TestRunTrigger.cs:36-50). The request graph replaces the saved graph (PipelineTestRunService.cs:108-124), and the editor sends draft.steps and the supplied inputs (WorkbenchView.vue:401-419). Defaults fill optional inputs (Application/Commands/Dtos/PipelineInputs.cs:141-161). The run mode resets to dry on each open (WorkbenchView.vue:364-369).

reader_answers.evidence: The labels New pipeline, Make pipeline, Add a step at the end, Send message under Chat, Message, Grant currency under Economy, Amount, Save, Pipeline saved., Dry run, Test run, Done, Failed, Did not run and Clear test run all match pipelines/i18n/en.json:6,24,170-171,194-214,283 and i18n/schema/en.json:1689,1693,3511,3550,3580,3619. Clear test run removes the results (WorkbenchView.vue:376-383, 457-463).

pipelines:write defaults to Mod (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:184), and test-run requires it (PipelinesController.cs:268). Live mode runs the real actions, including the obs, vts, discord and music categories, so those connections are needed (PipelineTestRunService.cs:157-158).

Step cards show their marks and the header shows the summary (WorkbenchView.vue:700-705, 768-780). LiveRunResult.vue:37-43 shows Ran for real: steps. RunsPanel.vue:114-119 shows the Test run and Live run badges. A captured send_message reports Success without sending (CapturingCommandAction.cs:62-79).

A command runs only a linked, enabled pipeline (Infrastructure/Commands/CommandInvoker.cs:108). A dry run captures send_message and grant_currency (PipelineTestRunService.cs:52-61, 157-167). A live run acts as the caller (TestRunTrigger.cs:36-50), and grant_currency credits TriggeredByUserId (Infrastructure/Economy/PipelineActions/GrantCurrencyAction.cs:53-66), so the moderator's own balance changes. The pipeline is linked on the Commands page (ReplyModeField.vue:125-158).
